title: Isandro and the Orchard
author: Juniper Thornbury
blurb: Elodie Almeida, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
